title: Mixing, editing: Letting Go by Wings | 1975
content:
Studio Three, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

Alan Parsons remixed and edited Wings’ song ‘Letting Go’ on 20 August 1975.

The song had already been included on the Venus And Mars album, but a remix was deemed necessary for its single release.

Parsons mixed the song, then edited almost a minute from the running time. The new version added an organ part in the intro that had been left off the original mix.
